items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution. It was addressed as part of a regularly scheduled security update.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: Another critical vulnerability resolved in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, allowing for arbitrary code execution upon successful exploitation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Remote Code Execution in OpenMage Magento LTS
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in OpenMage Magento Long Term Support (LTS) allows authenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by exploiting an incomplete blocklist in file uploads.

items.title: Unauthenticated Unrestricted File Upload (PolyShell)
items.summary: Sansec discovered 'PolyShell,' a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable polyglot files, bypassing validation and potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Full System Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, due to incorrect authorization, could allow attackers to execute code remotely and achieve full system takeover.

items.title: Improper Access Control leading to Data Leak
items.summary: A critical improper access control vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow attackers to bypass security filters and access restricted information, leading to data leaks.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Admin Hijacking
items.summary: This critical stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow malicious scripts to escalate user privileges and hijack admin sessions.
